name: Malecón de Miraflores
desc: Clifftop paths where paragliders float past and the Pacific hums below. The best free therapy session in Lima.

name: Parque del Amor
desc: A giant kissing statue, mosaic benches, ocean sunsets. Bring someone, or just bring headphones and feelings.

name: Huaca Pucllana
desc: A pre-Inca pyramid casually parked between apartment blocks. Five bucks to time-travel without leaving Miraflores.

name: Plaza Mayor de Lima
desc: Yellow colonial facades, palace guards, pigeon drama. The city's origin point, still free after 500 years.

name: Museo Larco
desc: Gold, ceramics, and a bougainvillea courtyard that looks rented for weddings. The one museum splurge everyone defends.

name: Circuito Mágico del Agua
desc: Laser-lit fountains you can run through for pocket change. Peak cheap-date engineering.

name: Puente de los Suspiros
desc: Barranco's wooden bridge of sighs. Legend says hold your breath crossing and wish. Wishes are still free.

name: Monasterio de San Francisco
desc: A gorgeous convent with bone-stacked catacombs underneath. Four dollars for a library upstairs and skulls downstairs.

name: Parque Kennedy
desc: The famous plaza where dozens of cats hold court among churro carts. Free admission, priceless committee of cats.

name: Mercado de Surquillo
desc: Where Lima's chefs shop at dawn: mountains of ají, fruit you cannot pronounce, fish still bragging about the ocean.
